detail: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited and vivo Mobile India Private Limited are forming a joint venture to carry on the business of original equipment manufacturing (OEM) of electronic devices, including smartphones, in India. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Dixon on this JV. The Firm's role included undertaking legal due diligence on vivo, advising on structuring of the transaction, and review and negotiation of transaction documents (including joint venture agreement, shareholders agreement and asset purchase agreement).
